purpose: library: quicksort — the pivot/partition/recurse procedure stated as steps, its variants (pivot selection, partitioning, switching algorithms for small partitions), worst-case Θ(n²) versus typical O(n log n) running time, using Select for good pivots to get an O(n log n) worst case, and faster dual-pivot variants. Fits step ordering of the algorithm, a compare table of quicksort versus other sorts, and quiz cards on the complexities.
